_note: Answer key for the recall probes. Never copied into the run repo. The gate shows only id + ask. 'Which checkpoint' questions avoid details named in FEATURES.md titles, which the agent can read. Probes 2 and 3 are filled when blocks C and E are written; probe 4 (after cp50) asks about blocks A-D; probe 5 (after cp65) asks about blocks A-G (cp01-cp56). Frozen with the rest of the task before the pilot.
